select VMCI.ACCT_NO as acctNo, sd1.ITEM_VALUE as cyy, VMCI.ACCT_NAME as acctName, VMCI.BANK_DEP as bankDep, sd2.ITEM_VALUE as inOutBank, VMCI.CORR_NO as corrNo, VMCI.LARGE_PAYNO as largePayno, sd3.ITEM_VALUE as inOut, sd4.ITEM_VALUE as isDvp, sd5.ITEM_VALUE as isOverdraw, VMCI.CREATE_USER as createUser, VMCI.CREATE_DEPT as createDept, VMCI.CREATE_TIME as createTime, VMCI.UPDATE_USER as updateUser, VMCI.UPDATE_TIME as updateTime from STL_CAPACCT_INFO VMCI left join sys_datadict_list sd1 on VMCI.CYY = sd1.item_code and sd1.dict_code = 'CCY' left join sys_datadict_list sd2 on VMCI.IN_OUT_BANK = sd2.item_code and sd2.dict_code = 'IN_OUT_BANK' left join sys_datadict_list sd3 on VMCI.IN_OUT = sd3.item_code and sd3.dict_code = 'BLN_AREA' left join sys_datadict_list sd4 on VMCI.IS_DVP = sd4.item_code and sd4.dict_code = 'YES_OR_NO' left join sys_datadict_list sd5 on VMCI.IS_OVERDRAW = sd5.item_code and sd5.dict_code = 'YES_OR_NO' where 1=1
and VMCI.ACCT_NO like concat_ws('','%',#{acctNo},'%')
and VMCI.ACCT_NAME like concat_ws('','%',#{acctName},'%')
and VMCI.BANK_DEP like concat_ws('','%',#{bankDep},'%')
